next_step: Finish scale POC (week of 2026-03-03) -> perf run with 120M embeddings; finalize security checklist
notes: Profile: platform for long-term code archival + internal dev search (monorepo history, CI artifacts, code reviews).
Primary ask: accurate code-level retrieval + reranking by semantic relevance and file-level signals (author, recent-changes, build-pass).
Scale: ~120M embeddings (mix of file-level and chunk-level vectors), expect growth to ~300M within 12 months.
Freshness: re-indexing cadence = nightly delta (high churn), full rebuild quarterly. Need incremental update pattern + low window for index staleness.
Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 200ms for single-turn code search queries at target throughput.
Throughput target: sustained 200 QPS peak bursts to 500 QPS during engineering events.
Cost sensitivity: wants cost-per-query under $0.004 at typical production mix; willing to trade slight latency for lower unit cost.
Model preferences: open-family models (Llama2, Mistral variants), exploring quantized 8-bit embeddings for storage reduction; reranker model could be smaller cross-encoder hosted on dedicated pool.
Routing/fallback: multi-pool routing — primary dedicated for low latency, fallback to hosted private pool in different region; auto-fallback on node drain.
Security/compliance: strict SSO via SAML, per-request audit logging, ability to bring their own KMS (HSM) and enforce key rotation policies.
Quotes from demo: 'We need search results that respect recent merges and ownership signals — recency matters more than raw embedding score in many cases.'
POC: 3-week evaluation — integrate connectors, run 2M -> 120M scaling test, validate reranking quality with internal bench of 6k queries.
Operations ask: clearly defined rollback on model updates, ability to pin embedding model version per index, preview traffic slicing for canary rerankers.
Drive links shared: security FAQ, network diagram, sample dataset manifest (S3 paths).
Stated timeline: procurement decision tied to successful scale run and legal signoff; exec buy-in after cost modeling exercise.
Internal: AE notes — early enthusiasm around Optimize recommendations; must get SE time for kernel/quant tuning during POC.
